data.description: The ticket resolve subcommand dispatch path (ticket dispatcher -> ticket_resolve() -> resolve_ticket_id()) is untested end-to-end. resolve_ticket_id() has direct unit tests in test-ticket-lib.sh, but the full subcommand pipeline exercising 'ticket resolve <alias>' through ticket_resolve() is not covered. Add a brief integration test similar to test-ticket-hardening-integration.sh Test 2.
data.title: ticket dispatcher: resolve subcommand has no integration test for full pipeline
